heading: Blaine Kinderknecht
bio: I've been taking pictures since the young age of eight, but I've been "professional" since I was 15.

I just graduated from Quinter High School and I'll be attending Fort Hays State University to further my education in digital media. My favorite part about photography is being able to capture moments for people to look back on in the future.
I love meeting new people and hearing new stories, so feel free to reach out — let's make a deal happen.
